speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Abdominal Musculature Strain (Right Lower Quadrant)

I have ruled out infectious causes, renal stones, and appendicitis so far given the normal ultrasound and lack of fever or urinary symptoms. Since the pain began during physical activity and your exam is negative for peritoneal signs, the clinical picture strongly suggests a muscle strain rather than a surgical abdomen.
